story: Van der Poel attacked in the opening kilometre and built an advantage of more than six minutes. A six-rider chase formed but was caught by the peloton. Quick-Step, Lidl-Trek and EF Education-EasyPost then reduced his lead without getting close enough to catch him. With 25 kilometres remaining, they gave up the chase and Visma took control. Honoré attacked 20 kilometres from the finish to take second, while Van der Poel completed a 176-kilometre solo victory by one minute.
